artifact: CaneGuard Model V2 provisional confidence caution threshold

provenance.note: Selected-checkpoint validation predictions; not genuine out-of-fold predictions. This threshold is provisional and must not be treated as an OOF estimate.

score_definition: For scans whose top class is not RSSI, score is the maximum softmax probability over Healthy, Mosaic, Rust, Smut, and RSSI. RSSI-top scans are excluded because the app ends them as a scan error; on included scans this equals the maximum of the four stored scan classes because RSSI is not top.

selection_rule.candidate_thresholds: 0.0, each distinct observed max score among non-RSSI-top rows, and 1.0
selection_rule.warning_rule: warn when score is strictly below threshold
selection_rule.optimization: maximize F1 for incorrect-prediction detection; ties prefer higher error recall, then higher threshold
